lines.en: It scuttles in short bursts along the ground.

lines.zh: 湿滑的节肢在落叶上打滑。
lines.en: My wet joints slip on the fallen leaves.
It loops once around a root.
Its slick body leaves a thin trail.

lines.zh: 它走走停停，像在嗅什么
lines.en: It stops and starts, as if sniffing.
A sudden dash carries it several blocks.

lines.zh: 它的节肢敲在石上嗒嗒响
lines.en: Legs tick on stone.
It follows the path through the trees.

lines.zh: 它贴着灌木底下穿过去
lines.en: It slips along under the bushes.
Its motion comes in twitches.

lines.zh: 它绕过水洼，没有踩进去
lines.en: It skirts a puddle without entering.

lines.zh: 它爬上一段倒木又下来
lines.en: It climbs a fallen log and drops off.
It quietly repositions behind you.
Its body is smaller than its shadow.
Every few steps it shivers.

lines.zh: 它一点点挪进树影深处
lines.en: It works its way into the deep shade.
It stops and twitches slowly.

lines.zh: 湿气在它身上凝成水珠
lines.en: Moisture beads on its body.

lines.zh: 它的节肢无规则地颤动
lines.en: Its limbs quiver without pattern.

lines.zh: 它缩成一团，像块湿石头
lines.en: It balls up like a wet stone.

lines.zh: 它忽然抬起头，抖了一下
lines.en: It lifts its head in a sudden jerk.

lines.zh: 有小虫靠近，它立刻转向
lines.en: An insect nears and it snaps around.

lines.zh: 它的表皮在水光里发亮
lines.en: Its hide shines with wet light.

lines.zh: 它慢慢张开又合上口器
lines.en: Its mouthparts open and close slowly.

lines.zh: 它伏在草叶上，像睡着了
lines.en: It rests on a blade of grass.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸几乎看不出来
lines.en: Its breathing is nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 它一动，附近的虫子就散开
lines.en: When it stirs, nearby insects scatter.

lines.zh: 它把身体贴在凉的石面上
lines.en: It presses itself to a cool stone.

lines.zh: 它的影子在抖，身子却没动
lines.en: Its shadow trembles while it stays still.

lines.zh: 它像被什么从内部拖着
lines.en: It moves as if dragged from inside.

lines.zh: 它抬起湿漉漉的头看你
lines.en: It lifts a wet head toward you.
That small body goes taut.

lines.zh: 它绕着你脚边转了一圈
lines.en: It circles your feet once.

lines.zh: 它对你的靴子很感兴趣
lines.en: Your boot clearly interests it.

lines.zh: 它忽然侧过身，退了一点
lines.en: It turns side-on and backs a little.

lines.zh: 它歪着头，判断你的大小
lines.en: It tilts, judging your size.
Its mouthparts part once.

lines.zh: 它对你没有敌意，只是好奇
lines.en: No hostility, only curiosity.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，像在等你靠近
lines.en: It stares as if waiting for you to come closer.
It makes a faint rasping sound.

lines.zh: 它被击中，猛地缩成一团
lines.en: Struck, it snaps into a ball.

lines.zh: 它发出一声细小的尖叫
lines.en: It gives a tiny shriek.
It tumbles twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 它的身体抖得更厉害了
lines.en: Its twitching grows violent.

lines.zh: 它往后退，缩到石头后面
lines.en: It retreats behind a stone.
Slime seeps from the wound.

lines.zh: 它的节肢有两条不动了
lines.en: Two of its legs stop moving.

lines.zh: 它试图钻进最近的缝里
lines.en: It tries to reach the nearest crack.
It lies on its side, twitching.
It pushes up, much slower now.

lines.zh: 它朝味道来的方向窜了一步
lines.en: It darts a step toward the smell.
It circles the food twice.
It touches it tentatively.
It lunges and clamps on.
It hauls the food backwards.
It eats fast, afraid of being robbed.
Afterward it licks the ground.
It looks up, waiting for the next bite.

lines.zh: 它把食物拖进树根缝里
lines.en: It drags the food into a root gap.
Its twitching speeds up with excitement.

lines.zh: 它撞上你的靴子，弹了一下
lines.en: It hits your boot and rebounds.
The knock flips it over.
It rights itself in a rush and darts away.

lines.zh: 它的节肢刮过你的脚背
lines.en: Its legs scrape over your foot.

lines.zh: 它退开半格，重新打量你
lines.en: It backs off and reassesses you.

lines.zh: 它把你当成一堵墙绕开
lines.en: It treats you as a wall and goes around.

lines.zh: 它一碰就缩，缩完又回来
lines.en: A touch makes it flinch, then it returns.

lines.zh: 它从你脚边挤过去，很轻
lines.en: It squeezes past your foot, barely felt.

lines.zh: 它抖了抖，抖掉碰撞的灰
lines.en: It shakes off the dust from the bump.

lines.zh: 它对着你所在的方向颤了一下
lines.en: It twitches toward where you stand.
Two seamites press close together.
Their limbs touch and tap.

lines.zh: 它们绕着彼此转着小圈
lines.en: They circle each other in tiny loops.
Their wet bodies touch for an instant.

lines.zh: 它们同时朝一个方向颤
lines.en: Both twitch the same way at once.
They slip into the same stone crack.

lines.zh: 它们的动作渐渐同步了
lines.en: Their movements slowly sync.

lines.zh: 一只替另一只清掉身上的泥
lines.en: One clears mud from the other.

lines.zh: 它们贴在一起，不再乱动
lines.en: They cling together and go still.

lines.zh: 树影里只剩细碎的摩擦声
lines.en: Only faint rasping remains in the shade.
It seizes the item and hauls it back.

lines.zh: 它把食物压在身子底下
lines.en: It pins the food under itself.

lines.zh: 它用口器一点点撕下来
lines.en: Its mouthparts worry pieces off.
It stuffs the item into a root gap.

lines.zh: 它叼着东西窜出好几格
lines.en: It bolts several blocks with the prize.
It eats while scanning around.
What it dislikes, it spits out.
It scrapes the crumbs into a heap.
Eating too fast, it drops half.

lines.zh: 它低头把掉的那块又叼起
lines.en: It dips and picks the dropped half back up.
Its body snaps straight.
It turns on you, limbs splayed.

lines.zh: 它发出一串急促的摩擦声
lines.en: A rapid rasping bursts from it.
It flattens, ready to dart.
Its mouthparts gape wide.
A brackish smell enters the air.
It has classed you as prey.
It shudders, then goes still.
It begins working to your flank.

lines.zh: 它的目光钉在你的脚踝
lines.en: Its stare fixes on your ankle.
It circles at your feet.
Dash, halt; it is closer each time.

lines.zh: 它试着从你影子里穿过
lines.en: It tries to slip through your shadow.
It suddenly is not where it was.
A wet glint flickers in the air.

lines.zh: 它出现在你身后的石上
lines.en: It appears on the stone behind you.
It probes but will not commit.
It avoids your hands and goes for feet.
Each pass comes with a twitch.
It has closed to half a block.
It leaps onto your ankle and bites.
A bite takes a small strip of skin.
It darts up and drops away.

lines.zh: 它的节肢抓着你的裤脚
lines.en: Its legs hook your trouser leg.
A quick bite at your fingers.
It hits your shoe and topples.
It bites, then blinks out of reach.
Its mouthparts tear and hold.
The second leap lands truer.

lines.zh: 它退到石缝里，又探出头
lines.en: It retreats to a crevice and peeks out.
The mud bulges upward.

lines.zh: 它从土里钻出半个身子
lines.en: It pushes half its body out of the soil.
A wet little mass is moving.

lines.zh: 它抖掉身上的土和黏液
lines.en: It shakes off dirt and slime.
It climbs onto a root and stops.

lines.zh: 一小片水光在草丛里亮起
lines.en: A wet shimmer lights in the grass.
It crawls out of a puddle.

lines.zh: 它的节肢抓着落叶作响
lines.en: Its legs crackle on fallen leaves.
It peeks out before emerging.

lines.zh: 林地多了一个会动的小点
lines.en: The wood gains a moving speck.

lines.zh: 它的表皮被烫得卷起来
lines.en: Heat curls its hide up.
It lands and a crack opens in its shell.

lines.zh: 它在水下挣扎着往上抓
lines.en: Underwater it claws for the surface.

lines.zh: 爆炸把它掀出好几格远
lines.en: The blast throws it several blocks.
An arrow pins it to the ground.

lines.zh: 魔法进体，它抽得像通电
lines.en: Magic hits and it jerks like live wire.
Starved down to a shell of itself.

lines.zh: 电光穿过它，它僵在当场
lines.en: Lightning passes through; it freezes.
The void inhales; it claws at the dirt.
